standard_prerequisites.name: Pullback compatibility
standard_prerequisites.use: For f = g o f-prime the pullbacks (f-prime)^* of g^* of A^(d) and f^* of A^(d) agree by functoriality of pullback.

core_obligations: Unfold both functors on a test scheme: a quadruple for (S-prime, A-prime) is a quadruple for (S, A) together with the factorization f = g o f-prime, the sheaf and map data being carried by the identification (f-prime)^*(A-prime)^(d) = (f-prime)^* g^* A^(d) = f^* A^(d).
The correspondence L = L-prime, psi = psi-prime is functorial in the test scheme, giving the canonical isomorphism F-prime_d = h_{S-prime} x_{h_S} F_d.
proof_roadmap: Unfold the quadruple data across the base change, identify the pullback algebras by the displayed chain, conclude.
difficulty_reason: Data-level identification of quadruples over the pulled-back algebra with quadruples over the original algebra factoring through g; fully displayed.
